key_catalysts: Next earnings date: 2026-10-01 — the next memory pricing and margin update will determine if the cyclical peak is here or if the supercycle has legs
HBM3E supply allocation updates through 2027 — any sign of capacity catching up with demand would invalidate the bullish memory thesis
deep_dives.disconfirming_evidence: A decisive reclaim of $954.9 (50MA) on above-average volume would invalidate the cyclical peak thesis and suggest the 3M parabolic run has further to go toward the $1513 analyst target — the -53% volume is a warning, not a certainty.
deep_dives.bull_scenario: MU reclaims 50MA, memory pricing re-accelerates on AI demand, rally to $1000-1050 (~8-13% upside) over 2-3 weeks toward the $1513 analyst target.
deep_dives.base_scenario: Choppy range-bound action between $880-960 as the market digests the parabolic run; the downtrend persists but the memory supercycle thesis keeps a floor under the stock, leading to a slow grind lower toward $850-900.
deep_dives.bear_scenario: Breakdown below $880 support triggers a cyclical peak sell-off toward $750-800 (~14-19% downside), particularly devastating if VIX expands above 18 and memory spot pricing rolls over.
